column3: The quotation is in capitals; “every declaration” is rendered “EVERY FACT,” and it adds “THE TESTIMONY.”
NASB follows the critical text without “I write”; “I have warned” is rendered “I have previously said,” and “I warn” is “I say in advance.”
NASB reorders the verse and renders “powerful” as “mighty.”
NASB follows the critical text without “if”; “by the power” is rendered “because of the power,” and it adds “directed.”
NASB follows the critical text; it swaps the two verbs “test” and “examine” and renders “failing” as “fail the test.”
NASB renders “are not unapproved” as “do not fail the test.”
NASB follows the critical text (“we pray”).
NASB follows the critical text without “now”; “perfection” is rendered “be made complete.”
NASB renders “treat with severity” as “use severity.”
NASB renders “be perfected” as “be made complete” and “be encouraged” as “be comforted.”
NASB ends the verse after the kiss; “All the saints greet you,” which ends v. 12 in the Greek, is NASB's v. 13.
NASB v. 13 is “All the saints greet you,” the end of v. 12 in the Greek; the benediction of Greek v. 13 is NASB's v. 14.
NASB v. 14 is the benediction, v. 13 in the Greek; it follows the critical text without “Amen” and the Textus Receptus subscription.
